reviews.title: Fantastic monitor
reviews.comment: I am very happy with this monitor, the image is clean, sharp and well lit, I like to play in the fps/rts mode, but have to switch to race mode when video editing and color grading in order to get correct colors. The speakers are ok (better than none) but as with most monitors they leave a lot to be desired. I purchased a pc sound bar and it actually fits right under the screen as if the two were made for one another. The stand is adjustable with just the right amount of tension. Plenty of inputs and a powered usb-a output and an audio out port that allows the soundbar to function connected directly to the monitor. If someone were to ask me to recommend a gaming monitor, I would point them towards this product model without hesitation.
reviews.author: Terry L.

reviews.title: Great monitors but this was ridiculous.
reviews.comment:
The monitors themselves are very, very nice for the price and I’m glad we got them and would definitely recommend. Setup takes less than a minute once plugged in (setting refresh rate mostly) very excited to continue using them in the future.
That being said, this was the most frustrating purchase I’ve ever made from Amazon. I ordered 2 of these monitors in March and the first monitor I received was disgusting, it was obviously opened previously, with the box cobbled back together with scotch tape, protective packaging was missing, it was missing the instruction booklet, had greasy fingerprint smears all over the screen and did not work, back light would come on but would not respond to any video input, why this returned item was sent out in that condition in the first place is beyond me. We received the second monitor the next day and it worked with no issues. We had to contact customer service and setup a return for the first one we received because they wouldn’t just replace it, it took about a week to get to their return facility and about 2 weeks for them to issue a refund which was very frustrating and finally in the middle of April we received a replacement monitor after reordering the item again.
As far as the monitors go, they function beautifully but Amazon really dropped the ball on this one.

reviews.title: Awesome PC Display!
reviews.comment:
Beautiful display!!!
So many built-in function options in the GamePlus menu such as FPS Counter, Crosshair, and even a Display Alignment setting to adjust corner to corner offset in case it seems off a bit but upon playing around with it it is already set nicely by default.
The 1440p resolution is so crisp, also has very vibrant colors, and the true blacks in-game is really good! The default brightness was a bit high but I changed that withing the Windows 11 display settings. Very impressive performance coming from the 180Hz refresh rate blew me away! The 27" screen was perfect for my small corner desk setup.
Set up was a breeze with the DP cable that was included in the box and simple to attach the stand. I really like the futuristic and rugged look of the line of TUF Gaming products and matches well with the other PC parts I combined such as the Motherboard, GPU, Mouse, Keyboard, Mouse pad, and cooling fans on my system.
I highly recommend this item if you are looking for a smaller size but powerful and price worthy display. Thank you, ASUS!!!
reviews.author: ShooterB80

reviews.title: Best PS5 monitor on a budget
reviews.comment:
Just updated from a 1080p 60hz tv to play Crimson Desert on my PS5
Looks amazing, crisp graphics, no tearing or blur, almost zero latency, menus easy to navigate, great price (I'm a late-adopting penny pincher).
Simple: if you're on a budget, JUST BUY THIS
